## 🤖 Claude

You have a Wayland desktop on this VM, so you can run the real app, not just headless checks. The desktop binary was never built in this tree, only the CLI, so I started that build in the background. Here is the ladder I would use at each stopping point, cheapest first.

**1. The gates.** This is the "is the tree sound" check and takes a few minutes.

```
cd ~/maluos-slides
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryHigh=4500M -p MemoryMax=6G cargo xtask ci
```

For just the new crates, which run in under a second:

```
cargo nextest run -p maluos-llm -p maluos-slides-assist -p maluos-slides-mcp
```

**2. The status doc and the snapshots.** `docs/maluos-slides/status.md` has one row per step with what was built and what was verified. The snapshots under `crates/maluos-slides-assist/snapshots/` are readable on their own: `context-sample.md` is exactly what the model sees of the sample deck, and `tools.json` is the tool table it is offered.

**3. A real turn against a real model.** This is the most honest test of the assistant right now. It runs headless, saves a `.pptx`, and prints every plan, tool call and the final report.

```
cargo run -p maluos-slides-assist --example ask -- ollama glm-5.3-flash:cloud "add a closing slide that thanks the audience" --sample --mode confirm --save ~/closing.pptx
```

In confirm mode it prompts you with the plan and waits for y, n or q. Use `--mode autopilot --yes` for a hands-off run, `--mode answer` to see it explain without touching anything, and `--open deck.pptx` to work on one of your own decks. Add `MALUOS_SLIDES_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to the shell and swap `ollama glm-5.3-flash:cloud` for `anthropic ""` to compare models.

**4. Look at the result.** There is no LibreOffice here, so render the saved deck to images and open them with the desktop image viewer:

```
target/debug/maluos-slides-cli render ~/closing.pptx --out ~/closing
target/debug/maluos-slides-cli info ~/closing.pptx
```

Or open it in the app once the build finishes: `target/debug/maluos-slides ~/closing.pptx`. Opening the same file in PowerPoint on another machine is the strongest check of the "real editable deck" goal, since that is the whole point of D9.

**5. Drive it from a chat client over MCP.** You can register the MCP server in Claude Code and talk to the deck from a chat, which is the closest thing to the finished product until the pane exists:

```
claude mcp add maluos-slides -- /home/maludb/maluos-slides/target/debug/maluos-slides-cli mcp
```

Then in a Claude Code session: "open the sample, add an agenda slide, render slide 2". That path exercises the same tool table the assistant uses.

**6. The app itself, from step 3.6 on.** Once the pane exists, `target/debug/maluos-slides --sample` opens on your desktop and you use it like PowerPoint. For scripted screenshots the app also runs with `--control 7990`, and the CLI's `app` subcommand can click, type and take a screenshot. Headless runs of that need `xvfb`, which is the one package I still cannot install without sudo:

```
sudo apt install xvfb bc
```

My recommendation for the end of each step: run the nextest line, run one `ask` example in confirm mode on the sample, and render the output. That takes about two minutes and covers the gates, the model loop and the file format. I will add a `maluos-slides-cli ask` subcommand in step 3.7, which replaces the example with a supported command.

## 🤖 Claude

The Slides application is now open on your desktop, in the window titled **malu-closing-slide**. It is the freshly built binary, showing the deck the assistant produced earlier today: the sample deck plus the "Thank you!" slide it added at the end. Scroll the thumbnail pane to slide 9 to see that one. Nine slides, the sections, the chart and the shape diagram all came through the `.pptx` round trip. The file is saved at `~/Documents/malu-closing-slide.pptx` if you want to open it elsewhere.

One caution: there is a second Slides window from the older installed package, started from `/usr/bin/maluos-slides`. It has none of this month's work. The window with the deck above is the one to judge.

**Why the earlier test looked like a terminal transcript.** Everything in Phase 3 so far is the machinery behind the assistant: the model client, the tool table, the deck outline, the loop and the safety rails. None of it has a face in the app yet. The only visible result of a turn today is the deck it writes, which is why the example saves a file and I opened that file in the app.

**What changes at the next stopping point.** Step 3.6 puts the assistant into this window: a pane on the right with the chat, the streaming answer, the plan to approve, the commands it ran with an Undo per turn, the mode selector and the model picker, plus an "Ask Malu" button and Ctrl+Shift+A. From then on, testing a step means opening the app, typing a request into the pane and watching the slides change. That is the "Cursor for presentations" experience, and it is the next thing to build.

## 🤖 Claude

You can't yet. The assistant pane is step 3.6, which has not been built. Everything so far runs underneath the app: the model client, the tool table, the outline, the loop and the rails all exist and are tested, but nothing in the window shows them.

Today the only ways to use the assistant are the two headless paths:

- The example command, which runs a turn and saves a deck you then open in the app, as I did a moment ago.
- The MCP server, which lets a chat client such as Claude Code drive the deck through the same tools.

Step 3.6 is what puts it on screen: a pane on the right of this window with the chat, the streaming answer, the plan to approve, the commands it ran with Undo per turn, the mode selector and the model picker, plus an "Ask Malu" ribbon button and Ctrl+Shift+A. Once it lands, you open the app, press the shortcut and type.

Say "Start Phase 3.6" and I will build it. It is the largest Phase 3 step since it touches the egui UI crate through fenced hooks, so plan on it taking longer than the previous ones.

use egui::{Align2, Color32, CornerRadius, Rect, Sense, Stroke, Ui, pos2, vec2};

pub fn show(app: &mut SlideApp, ui: &mut Ui) {
    let t = Tokens::get(ui.ctx());
    let Some(pane) = app.ui.pane.clone() else { return };
    egui::Panel::right("task_pane")
        .resizable(true)
        .default_size(app.ui.pane_width)
        .size_range(240.0..=520.0)
        .frame(egui::Frame::NONE.fill(t.card).inner_margin(egui::Margin::same(10)))
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            app.ui.pane_width = ui.available_width() + 20.0;
            let title = match pane.as_str() {
                "format" => "Format Shape",
                "background" => "Format Background",
                "animation" => "Animation Pane",
                "selection" => "Selection",
                "comments" => "Comments",
                "designer" => "Design Ideas",
                "smartart" => "Text Pane",
                "thesaurus" => "Thesaurus",
                "revisions" => "Revisions",
                _ => "Pane",
            };
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.label(egui::RichText::new(title).font(theme::bold(16.0)));
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    let (r, resp) = ui.allocate_exact_size(vec2(20.0, 20.0), Sense::click());
                    if resp.hovered() {
                        ui.painter().rect_filled(r, CornerRadius::same(4), t.hover);
                    }
                    icons::paint(ui.painter(), r.shrink(3.0), Icon::Close, t.text_dim, false);
                    if resp.clicked() {
                        app.ui.pane = None;
                    }
                });
            });
            ui.add_space(6.0);
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false, false]).show(ui, |ui| match pane.as_str() {
                "format" => format_shape(app, ui),
                "background" => background(app, ui),
                "animation" => animation(app, ui),
                "selection" => crate::selpane::show(app, ui),
                "comments" => comments(app, ui),
                "designer" => designer(app, ui),
                "smartart" => smartart(app, ui),
                "thesaurus" => thesaurus(app, ui),
                "revisions" => revisions(app, ui),
                _ => {}
            });
        });
}

    pub fn run(&mut self, id: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, String> {
        let r = if UI_COMMANDS.iter().any(|c| c.0 == id) {
            self.run_ui(id, &params)

fn load_prefs(app: &mut SlideApp) {
    if std::env::var_os("MALUOS_SLIDES_NO_PREFS").is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(dir) = config_dir() else { return };
    let (ui, prefs) = maluos_slides_ui_egui::settings::load(&dir);
    if let Some(ui) = ui {
        app.ui = ui;
    }
    if let Some(prefs) = prefs {
        app.session.prefs = prefs;
    }
}

macro_rules! icons {
    ($($(#[$m:meta])* $v:ident => $n:literal,)*) => {
        /// Every icon MaluOS Slides draws.
        #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
        pub enum Icon {
            $($(#[$m])* $v,)*
        }

        impl Icon {
            /// All icons, in declaration order.
            pub const ALL: &'static [Icon] = &[$(Icon::$v,)*];

            /// Stable kebab-case name, e.g. `"format-painter"`.
            pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
                match self {
                    $(Icon::$v => $n,)*
                }
            }

            /// Inverse of [`Icon::name`].
            pub fn from_name(s: &str) -> Option<Icon> {
                match s {
                    $($n => Some(Icon::$v),)*
                    _ => None,
                }
            }
        }
    };
}

//! The Selection pane driven like a person would: clicks, Ctrl+click, drag and drop, the eye,
//! the padlock, renaming and the keyboard.

use egui::{Modifiers, Pos2};
use egui_kittest::Harness;
use egui_kittest::kittest::Queryable;
use maluos_slides_engine::Session;
use serde_json::json;

use crate::{Services, SlideApp};

/// A blank slide with A, B, C (back to front) and the group G = [D, E] in front; the pane open.
fn harness() -> (Harness<'static, SlideApp>, Vec<u32>) {
    let mut s = Session::with_new();
    s.execute("slide.new", &json!({"layout": "blank"})).unwrap();
    let mut ids = vec![];
    for (i, n) in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"].iter().enumerate() {
        let r = s.execute("shape.insert", &json!({"preset": "rect", "rect": [20.0 + 110.0 * i as f64, 50, 100, 80]})).unwrap();
        let id = r["id"].as_u64().unwrap() as u32;

            app.ui(ui);

    h.run_steps(3);

}

fn names(h: &Harness<'_, SlideApp>) -> String {
    fn rec(v: &[maluos_slides_model::Shape]) -> String {
        v.iter().map(|x| if x.is_group() { format!("{}[{}]", x.name, rec(x.children())) } else { x.name.clone() }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
    }
    rec(h.state().session.active().unwrap().shapes())
}

fn selected(h: &Harness<'_, SlideApp>) -> Vec<String> {
    let st = h.state().session.active().unwrap();
    st.selection.shapes.iter().filter_map(|i| st.shape(*i)).map(|s| s.name.clone()).collect()
}

fn row(h: &Harness<'_, SlideApp>, name: &str) -> egui::Rect {
    h.get_by_label(name).rect()
}

Some(r), .. } => Some(r),\n            _ => None,\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn set_mode(&mut self, mode: Mode) {\n        if self.mode != mode {\n            self.mode = mode;\n            if let Some(a) = &mut self.assistant {\n                a.set_mode(mode);\n            }\n            self.config_dirty = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn set_provider(&mut self, provider: ProviderChoice) {\n        if self.provider != provider {\n            self.provider = provider;\n            self.model = provider.default_model().into();\n            self.assistant = None;\n            self.config_dirty = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn set_model(&mut self, model: String) {\n        if self.model != model {\n            self.model = model;\n            if let Some(a) = &mut self.assistant {\n                a.model = self.model.clone();\n            }\n            self.config_dirty = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Where the key comes from, or why there is none.\n    pub fn provider_status(&self) -> (bool, String) {\n        match self.provider {\n            ProviderChoice::Anthropic | ProviderChoice::OpenAi => {\n                let p = if self.provider == ProviderChoice::Anthropic { Provider::Anthropic } else { Provider::OpenAi };\n                match p.env_vars().iter().find(|v| std::env::var(v).map(|k| !k.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or(false)) {\n                    Some(v) => (true, format!(\"key from {v}\")),\n                    None => (false, format!(\"no key: set {}\", p.env_vars()[0])),\n                }\n            }\n            ProviderChoice::Ollama => (true, format!(\"{} (no key needed)\", ollama_url())),\n            ProviderChoice::Custom => (true, \"custom client\".into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn client(&self) -> Result<Arc<dyn LlmClient>, String> {\n        if let Some(c) = &self.custom_client {\n            return Ok(c.clone());\n        }\n        #[cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")]\n        {\n            Err(\"the assistant needs the desktop app\".into())\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))]\n        {\n            match self.provider {\n                ProviderChoice::Anthropic => maluos_llm::AnthropicClient::from_env().map(|c| Arc::new(c) as Arc<dyn LlmClient>).map_err(|e| e.to_string()),\n                ProviderChoice::OpenAi => maluos_llm::OpenAiClient::openai_from_env().map(|c| Arc::new(c) as Arc<dyn LlmClient>).map_err(|e| e.to_string()),\n                ProviderChoice::Ollama => {\n                    let t = Arc::new(maluos_llm::UreqTransport::default());\n                    Ok(Arc::new(maluos_llm::OpenAiClient::compatible(t, \"ollama\", ollama_url(), None)))\n                }\n                ProviderChoice::Custom => Err(\"no client\".into()),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn assistant(&mut self) -> Result<&mut Assistant, String> {\n        if self.assistant.is_none() {\n            let client = self.client()?;\n            let a = Assistant::new(client, self.model.clone()).with_mode(self.mode);\n            self.assistant = Some(a);\n        }\n        self.assistant.as_mut().ok_or_else(|| \"no assistant\".to_string())\n    }\n}\n\nfn ollama_url() -> String {\n    std::env::var(\"MALUOS_SLIDES_OLLAMA_URL\").ok().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or_else(|| maluos_llm::openai::OLLAMA_BASE_URL.to_string())\n}\n\n// ---------- config ----------\n\nconst CONFIG_FILE: &str = \"assistant.json\";\n\nfn config_dir() -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {\n    if std::env::var_os(\"MALUOS_SLIDES_NO_PREFS\").is_some() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    std::env::var_os(\"XDG_CONFIG_HOME\")\n        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)\n        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os(\"HOME\").map(|h| std::path::PathBuf::from(h).join(\".config\")))\n        .map(|d| d.join(\"maluos-slides\"))\n}\n\nfn load_config(state: &mut State) {\n    state.config_loaded = true;\n    let Some(dir) = config_dir() else { return };\n    let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(CONFIG_FILE)) else { return };\n    let Ok(c) = serde_json::from_str::<Config>(&text) else { return };\n    state.provider = c.provider;\n    state.model = if c.model.trim().is_empty() { c.provider.default_model().into() } else { c.model };\n    state.mode = Mode::parse(&c.mode).unwrap_or(Mode::Confirm);\n}\n\nfn save_config(state: &mut State) {\n    state.config_dirty = false;\n    if state.custom_client.is_some() {\n        return;\n    }\n    let Some(dir) = config_dir() else { return };\n    let c = Config { provider: state.provider, model: state.model.clone(), mode: state.mode.as_str().into() };\n    let Ok(text) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&c) else { return };\n    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);\n    if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(dir.join(CONFIG_FILE), text) {\n        log::warn!(\"assistant.json: {e}\");\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------- the host: the app as the assistant's backend ----------\n\nstruct AppHost<'a> {\n    app: &'a mut SlideApp,\n}\n\nimpl Backend for AppHost<'_> {\n    fn call(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, String> {\n        let s = |k: &str| params.get(k).and_then(Value::as_str).map(String::from);\n        match method {\n            \"engine.execute\" | \"command\" | \"ui.menu.invoke\" => {\n                let id = s(\"command\").or_else(|| s(\"id\")).ok_or(\"missing `command`\")?;\n                let p = params.get(\"params\").cloned().filter(|v| !v.is_null()).unwrap_or(json!({}));\n                self.app.run(&id, p)\n            }\n            \"engine.commands\" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(self.app.session.commands()).unwrap_or_default()),\n            \"document.inspect\" => self.app.run(\"document.inspect\", json!({})),\n            \"ui.render\" | \"app.renderSlide\" => {\n                let d = self.app.session.active().ok_or(\"no presentation open\")?;\n                let i = params.get(\"slide\").and_then(Value::as_u64).map(|v| v as usize).unwrap_or(d.selection.slide);\n                if i >= d.doc.slides.len() {\n                    return Err(format!(\"no slide {i}\"));\n                }\n                let scale = params.get(\"scale\").and_then(Value::as_f64).unwrap_or(1.0).clamp(0.05, 8.0);\n                let (png, w, h) = maluos_slides_engine::cmd::file::render_png(&d.doc, i, scale, params.get(\"edit\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false));\n                Ok(json!({\"png\": maluos_slides_engine::cmd::base64_encode(&png), \"width\": w, \"height\": h, \"slide\": i}))\n            }\n            \"ui.tool.select\" => {\n                let name = s(\"tool\").ok_or(\"missing `tool`\")?;\n                let kind = crate::control::tool_kind(&name, params.get(\"preset\").and_then(Value::as_str)).ok_or_else(|| format!(\"unknown tool `{name}`\"))?;\n                self.app.session.set_tool(kind);\n                Ok(json!({\"tool\": name}))\n            }\n            \"ui.key\" => {\n                let key = s(\"key\").ok_or(\"missing `key`\")?;\n                let m = maluos_slides_engine::Mods {\n                    shift: params.get(\"shift\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                    alt: params.get(\"alt\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                    cmd: params.get(\"cmd\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false) || params.get(\"ctrl\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                };\n                self.app.session.key(&key, m).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n            }\n            \"ui.text\" => {\n                let t = s(\"text\").ok_or(\"missing `text`\")?;\n                self.app.session.type_text(&t).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n            }\n            \"ui.pointer\" => {\n                let events = params.get(\"events\").and_then(Value::as_array).ok_or(\"missing `events`\")?;\n                let mut last = Value::Null;\n                for e in events {\n                    let kind = match e.get(\"kind\").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or(\"\") {\n                        \"down\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::Down,\n                        \"drag\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::Drag,\n                        \"up\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::Up,\n                        \"move\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::Move,\n                        \"doubleclick\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::DoubleClick,\n                        \"tripleclick\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::TripleClick,\n                        \"contextclick\" => maluos_slides_engine::PointerKind::ContextClick,\n                        other => return Err(format!(\"unknown pointer kind `{other}`\")),\n                    };\n                    let x = e.get(\"x\").and_then(Value::as_f64).ok_or(\"pointer event needs `x`\")?;\n                    let y = e.get(\"y\").and_then(Value::as_f64).ok_or(\"pointer event needs `y`\")?;\n                    let m = e.get(\"mods\").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);\n                    let mods = maluos_slides_engine::Mods {\n                        shift: m.get(\"shift\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                        alt: m.get(\"alt\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                        cmd: m.get(\"cmd\").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false),\n                    };\n                    last = self.app.session.pointer(maluos_slides_engine::PointerEvent { kind, x, y, mods, tol: 3.0, pressure: None }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                }\n                Ok(json!({\"result\": last}))\n            }\n            other => Err(format!(\"`{other}` is not available from the assistant pane\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Screenshots go through the frame loop asynchronously; `render_slide` serves the model.\n    fn has_ui(&self) -> bool {\n        false\n    }\n\n    fn describe(&self) -> String {\n        \"the MaluOS Slides window\".into()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Host for AppHost<'_> {\n    fn session(&self) -> &maluos_slides_engine::Session {\n        &self.app.session\n    }\n    fn session_mut(&mut self) -> &mut maluos_slides_engine::Session {\n        &mut self.app.session\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------- driving a turn ----------\n\n/// Sends what is in the input box. Nothing happens while a turn runs or the box is empty.\npub fn send(app: &mut SlideApp, ctx: &egui::Context) {\n    let text = app.malu.input.trim().to_string();\n    if text.is_empty() || app.malu.busy() {\n        return;\n    }\n    if app.session.active().is_none() {\n        app.malu.problem = Some(\"Open or create a presentation first.\".into());\n        return;\n    }\n    if let Err(e) = app.malu.assistant() {\n        app.malu.problem = Some(e);\n        return;\n    }\n    app.malu.problem = None;\n    app.malu.input.clear();\n    app.malu.transcript.push(Entry::User(text.clone()));\n    app.malu.transcript.push(Entry::Assistant { text: String::new(), thinking: String::new(), calls: vec![], report: None });\n    let Some(mut assistant) = app.malu.assistant.take() else { return };\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    let (turn, step) = {\n        let mut host = AppHost { app };\n        assistant.begin(&mut host, &text, &mut |e| {\n            events.push(e);\n            Flow::Continue\n        })\n    };\n    app.malu.assistant = Some(assistant);\n    app.malu.turn = Some(turn);\n    apply_events(app, events);\n    handle_step(app, ctx, step);\n}\n\n/// Stops the running turn: the model call is abandoned, a waiting plan is cancelled.\npub fn stop(app: &mut SlideApp, ctx: &egui::Context) {\n    if let Some(w) = &app.malu.worker {\n        w.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n    app.malu.worker = None;\n    app.malu.pending_plan = None;\n    let (Some(mut assistant), Some(mut turn)) = (app.malu.assistant.take(), app.malu.turn.take()) else { return };\n    let step = {\n        let mut host = AppHost { app };\n        assistant.cancel(&mut turn, &mut host)\n    };\n    app.malu.assistant = Some(assistant);\n    app.malu.turn = Some(turn);\n    handle_step(app, ctx, step);\n}\n\n/// The user answered the plan.\npub fn answer_plan(app: &mut SlideApp, ctx: &egui::Context, verdict: Verdict) {\n    app.malu.pending_plan = None;\n    let (Some(mut assistant), Some(mut turn)) = (app.malu.assistant.take(), app.malu.turn.take()) else { return };\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    let step = {\n        let mut host = AppHost { app };\n        assistant.on_verdict(&mut turn, &mut host, verdict, &mut |e| {\n            events.push(e);\n            Flow::Continue\n        })\n    };\n    app.malu.assistant = Some(assistant);\n    app.malu.turn = Some(turn);\n    apply_events(app, events);\n    handle_step(app, ctx, step);\n}\n\n/// Called every frame: takes what the worker streamed and advances the turn when the model\n/// answered.\npub fn poll(app: &mut SlideApp, ctx: &egui::Context) {\n    if app.malu.config_dirty {\n        save_config(&mut app.malu);\n    }\n    let Some(worker) = app.malu.worker.as_ref() else { return };\n    if worker.generation != app.malu.generation {\n        app.malu.worker = None;\n        return;\n    }\n    let mut done = None;\n    let mut text = String::new();\n    let mut thinking = String::new();\n    while let Ok(m) = worker.rx.try_recv() {\n        match m {\n            Msg::Text(t) => text.push_str(&t),\n            Msg::Thinking(t) => thinking.push_str(&t),\n            Msg::Done(r) => {\n                done = Some(r);\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if !text.is_empty() || !thinking.is_empty() {\n        append_streaming(app, &text, &thinking);\n    }\n    if app.malu.worker.is_some() {\n        ctx.request_repaint_after(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));\n    }\n    let Some(result) = done else { return };\n    app.malu.worker = None;\n    let (Some(mut assistant), Some(mut turn)) = (app.malu.assistant.take(), app.malu.turn.take()) else { return };\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    let step = {\n        let mut host = AppHost { app };\n        assistant.on_completion(&mut turn, &mut host, result, &mut |e| {\n            events.push(e);\n            Flow::Continue\n        })\n    };\n    app.malu.assistant = Some(assistant);\n    app.malu.turn = Some(turn);\n    apply_events(app, events);\n    handle_step(app, ctx, step);\n}\n\nfn handle_step(app: &mut SlideApp, ctx: &egui::Context, step: Step) {\n    match step {\n        Step::Model(request) => {\n            let Some(assistant) = app.malu.assistant.as_ref() else { return };\n            let call = assistant.model_call();\n            let (tx, rx) = channel();\n            let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n            app.malu.generation += 1;\n            let generation = app.malu.generation;\n            app.malu.worker = Some(Worker { rx, stop: stop.clone(), generation });\n            spawn_model_call(call, request, tx, stop, ctx.clone());\n            ctx.request_repaint();\n        }\n        Step::Confirm(plan) => {\n            app.malu.pending_plan = Some(plan);\n            ctx.request_repaint();\n        }\n        Step::Done(report) => {\n            app.malu.turn = None;\n            app.malu.pending_plan = None;\n            finish_entry(app, report);\n            ctx.request_repaint();\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))]\nfn spawn_model_call(call: maluos_slides_assist::ModelCall, request: maluos_llm::Request, tx: Sender<Msg>, stop: Arc<AtomicBool>, ctx: egui::Context) {\n    std::thread::Builder::new()\n        .name(\"malu-model\".into())\n        .spawn(move || {\n            let result = call.run(&request, &mut |e| {\n                if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                    return Flow::Stop;\n                }\n                match e {\n                    Event::TextDelta(t) => {\n                        let _ = tx.send(Msg::Text(t));\n                        ctx.request_repaint();\n                    }\n                    Event::ThinkingDelta(t) => {\n                        let _ = tx.send(Msg::Thinking(t));\n                        ctx.request_repaint();\n                    }\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n                Flow::Continue\n            });\n            let _ = tx.send(Msg::Done(result));\n            ctx.request_repaint();\n        })\n        .map(|_| ())\n        .unwrap_or_else(|e| log::error!(\"assistant thread: {e}\"));\n}\n\n#[cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")]\nfn spawn_model_call(_call: maluos_slides_assist::ModelCall, _request: maluos_llm::Request, tx: Sender<Msg>, _stop: Arc<AtomicBool>, _ctx: egui::Context) {\n    let _ = tx.send(Msg::Done(Err(LlmError::Transport(\"the assistant needs the desktop app\".into()))));\n}\n\nfn current_entry(app: &mut SlideApp) -> Option<&mut Entry> {\n    app.malu.transcript.iter_mut().rev().find(|e| matches!(e, Entry::Assistant { report: None, .. }))\n}\n\nfn append_streaming(app: &mut SlideApp, text: &str, thinking: &str) {\n    if let Some(Entry::Assistant { text: t, thinking: th, .. }) = current_entry(app) {\n        t.push_str(text);\n        th.push_str(thinking);\n    }\n}\n\nfn apply_events(app: &mut SlideApp, events: Vec<TurnEvent>) {\n    for e in events {\n        match e {\n            TurnEvent::Round(n) if n > 1 => {\n                // A new round: the text so far was the model thinking aloud before its calls;\n                // keep it, separated, so the final answer reads on its own.\n                if let Some(Entry::Assistant { text, .. }) = current_entry(app)\n                    && !text.is_empty()\n                    && !text.ends_with('\\n')\n                {\n                    text.push_str(\"\\n\\n\");\n                }\n            }\n            TurnEvent::ToolDone(o) => {\n                if let Some(Entry::Assistant { calls, .. }) = current_entry(app) {\n                    calls.push(ToolCall { name: o.name.clone(), input: Value::Null, ok: !o.is_error, summary: o.text.lines().next().unwrap_or(\"\").chars().take(120).collect() });\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn finish_entry(app: &mut SlideApp, report: TurnReport) {\n    let note = match (&report.error, &report.stopped) {\n        (Some(e), _) => Some(format!(\"The model call failed: {e}\")),\n        (None, Some(maluos_slides_assist::Stop::Cancelled)) => Some(\"Stopped.\".into()),\n        (None, Some(maluos_slides_assist::Stop::RoundLimit)) => Some(\"Stopped after the round limit; the deck may be half-changed (Undo reverts the turn).\".into()),\n        (None, Some(maluos_slides_assist::Stop::ToolCallLimit)) => Some(\"Reached the tool-call limit for one turn.\".into()),\n        (None, Some(maluos_slides_assist::Stop::Refusal)) => Some(\"The model declined this request.\".into()),\n        (None, Some(maluos_slides_assist::Stop::MaxTokens)) => Some(\"The answer was cut by the output limit.\".into()),\n        (None, None) => None,\n    };\n    if let Some(Entry::Assistant { text, calls, report: r, .. }) = current_entry(app) {\n        if !report.answer.is_empty() && !text.ends_with(&report.answer) {\n            if !text.is_empty() {\n                text.push_str(\"\\n\\n\");\n            }\n            text.push_str(&report.answer);\n        }\n        // The report's calls carry the inputs; keep its view, it is complete.\n        *calls = report.tool_calls.clone();\n        *r = Some(report);\n    }\n    if let Some(n) = note {\n        app.malu.transcript.push(Entry::Note(n));\n    }\n    if app.session.active().is_some() {\n        app.set_status(\"Malu finished a turn\");\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------- the pane ----------\n\npub fn show(app: &mut SlideApp, ui: &mut Ui) {\n    if !app.malu.config_loaded {\n        load_config(&mut app.malu);\n    }\n    let ctx = ui.ctx().clone();\n    let t = Tokens::get(&ctx);\n    poll(app, &ctx);\n\n    settings_row(app, ui, &t);\n    ui.add_space(4.0);\n    let (ok, status) = app.malu.provider_status();\n    ui.label(RichText::new(format!(\"{} · {}\", app.malu.provider.label(), status)).small().color(if ok { t.text_dim } else { crate::icons::RED }));\n    if let Some(p) = &app.malu.problem {\n        ui.label(RichText::new(p).small().color(crate::icons::RED));\n    }\n    ui.add_space(6.0);\n\n    // The conversation fills what the input box leaves.\n    let input_h = 96.0;\n    let avail = ui.available_height() - input_h;\n    egui::ScrollArea::vertical().id_salt(\"malu_transcript\").max_height(avail.max(80.0)).auto_shrink([false, false]).stick_to_bottom(true).show(ui, |ui| {\n        transcript(app, ui, &ctx, &t);\n    });\n    ui.add_space(6.0);\n    input_row(app, ui, &ctx, &t);\n}\n\nfn settings_row(app: &mut SlideApp, ui: &mut Ui, _t: &Tokens) {\n    let busy = app.malu.busy();\n    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {\n        let mut provider = app.malu.provider;\n        if provider != ProviderChoice::Custom {\n            egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(\"malu_provider\").selected_text(provider.label()).width(96.0).show_ui(ui, |ui| {\n                for p in ProviderChoice::ALL {\n                    ui.selectable_value(&mut provider, p, p.label());\n                }\n            });\n            if !busy {\n                app.malu.set_provider(provider);\n            }\n        }\n        let mut model = app.malu.model.clone();\n        let suggestions = app.malu.provider.suggestions();\n        let r = egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(\"malu_model\").selected_text(model.clone()).width(150.0).show_ui(ui, |ui| {\n            for m in suggestions {\n                ui.selectable_value(&mut model, m.to_string(), *m);\n            }\n            ui.separator();\n            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut model).hint_text(\"model name\").desired_width(140.0));\n        });\n        r.response.on_hover_text(\"The model to ask; type any name your provider serves\");\n        if !busy {\n            app.malu.set_model(model);\n        }\n        let mut mode = app.malu.mode;\n        egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(\"malu_mode\")\n            .selected_text(match mode {\n                Mode::AnswerOnly => \"Answer only\",\n                Mode::Confirm => \"Confirm changes\",\n                Mode::Autopilot => \"Autopilot\",\n            })\n            .width(130.0)\n            .show_ui(ui, |ui| {\n                ui.selectable_value(&mut mode, Mode::AnswerOnly, \"Answer only\").on_hover_text(\"Reads and explains; changes nothing\");\n                ui.selectable_value(&mut mode, Mode::Confirm, \"Confirm changes\").on_hover_text(\"Shows each change as a plan to approve\");\n                ui.selectable_value(&mut mode, Mode::Autopilot, \"Autopilot\").on_hover_text(\"Applies changes at once; deletions still ask\");\n            });\n        app.malu.set_mode(mode);\n    });\n}\n\nfn transcript(app: &mut SlideApp, ui: &mut Ui, ctx: &egui::Context, t: &Tokens) {\n    if app.malu.transcript.is_empty() {\n        ui.label(RichText::new(\"Ask for a change to the open presentation, or a question about it. The selection is the target when you say \\\"this\\\".\").color(t.text_dim));\n        ui.add_space(4.0);\n        for ex in [\"Tighten the title on this slide\", \"Add a closing slide that thanks the audience\", \"Turn these bullets into a 2×3 table\"] {\n            if ui.add(egui::Button::new(RichText::new(ex).small()).frame(false)).clicked() {\n                app.malu.input = ex.into();\n                app.malu.focus_input = true;\n            }\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    let top_undo = app.session.active().and_then(|d| d.history.undo.last().map(|e| e.label.clone()));\n    let mut undo_click = false;\n    let mut toggle_thinking = false;\n    let show_thinking = app.malu.show_thinking;\n    let streaming = app.malu.waiting_for_model();\n    let n = app.malu.transcript.len();\n    for (i, entry) in app.malu.transcript.iter().enumerate() {\n        match entry {\n            Entry::User(text) => {\n                ui.add_space(4.0);\n ## 🤖 Claude

Phase 3.6 is done, committed as `2b21e8b1` and pushed. The assistant is now inside the application, and it is running on your desktop right now in the window titled Northern Lights.

**How to use it.** Click the spark button in the title bar next to Present, or press Ctrl+Shift+A. The pane called Malu opens on the right with the chat box focused. Type a request and press Enter. Three screenshots of a live run are in `docs/maluos-slides/screenshots/`, linked from the status file.

**What the pane has.**
- Provider, model and mode pickers along the top, with a status line saying where the key comes from. With no Anthropic or OpenAI key in the environment it picks Ollama on its own, which is why it came up ready on this machine. Your choices are saved between runs. Keys never are.
- The conversation with streaming text, a "Show reasoning" toggle, one line per tool call with its compact result, and "Changed slide 9" style notes.
- In confirm mode, the default, a plan card appears before any change: what Malu wants to do and the engine commands behind it, with Approve, Decline and Stop. Autopilot skips the card except for deletions.
- An Undo button on each answer that reverts the whole turn, as long as it is still the top of the history. Stop ends a turn. Clear forgets the conversation.

**How it works underneath.** The loop from step 3.4 became a step machine the frame loop drives one event at a time. The model call runs on a worker thread and streams back through a channel. Every tool call runs on the UI thread through the app's own command path, so the window never blocks and each change is an ordinary command with the app's undo and status line. The existing blocking entry point is now a thin driver over the same machine, so every earlier test still passes.

**Verification.** 1,827 tests pass across the workspace, with the one known host-font failure in the PDF crate excluded. Five new window tests drive the pane through the egui test harness with a scripted model. Clippy, rustfmt, the layering check, the asset check and the wasm check are all green. The full `cargo xtask ci` stops early on that PDF test, so I ran the remaining gates by hand.

**Fenced hooks.** The pane is one new file in the UI crate plus small marked hooks: the module line, one field on the app, two commands, one shortcut row, one title-bar button, one icon, two lines in the pane dispatcher and one poll call. The Ask Malu button went into the title bar rather than the Home ribbon, which overflows at this window width.

Next is step 3.7, the `maluos-slides-cli ask` subcommand for scripts, which also replaces the example program. I will start when you say so.

macro_rules! outln {
    ($($arg:tt)*) => {{
        use std::io::Write as _;
        if let Err(e) = writeln!(std::io::stdout(), $($arg)*) {
            if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe {
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            eprintln!("maluos-slides-cli: can't write to stdout: {e}");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }};

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    let rest = args.get(1..).unwrap_or(&[]);
    let asks_help = rest.iter().any(|a| a == "--help" || a == "-h");
    if let Some(page) = args.first().filter(|_| asks_help).and_then(|n| help::page(n)) {
        outln!("{page}");
        return ExitCode::SUCCESS;
    }
    match args.first().map(String::as_str) {
        Some("help" | "--help" | "-h") => match rest.first() {
            None => {
                outln!("{}", help::overview());
                ExitCode::SUCCESS
            }
            Some(name) => match help::page(name) {
                Some(page) => {
                    outln!("{page}");
                    ExitCode::SUCCESS
                }
                None => unknown(name),
            },
        },
        Some("--version" | "-V" | "version") => {
            outln!("maluos-slides-cli {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
            ExitCode::SUCCESS
        }
        Some("info") => report(info(rest)),
        Some("bench") => report(bench(rest)),
        Some("render") => report(render(rest)),
        Some("render-transition") => report(render_transition(rest)),
        Some("convert") => report(convert(rest)),
        Some("run") => report(run(rest)),

            let f = rest.first().map(|x| x.to_lowercase());

                .iter()
                .filter(|c| f.as_ref().is_none_or(|f| c.id.to_lowercase().contains(f.as_str()) || c.label.to_lowercase().contains(f.as_str())))
            {
                match c.params.strip_prefix("{}") {
                    Some(answer) => outln!("{} — {}{answer}", c.id, c.label),
                    None => outln!("{} — {}: {}", c.id, c.label, c.params),
                }
            }

        }

        Some("app") => report(app(rest)),
        Some("mcp") => report(mcp(rest)),

            ExitCode::SUCCESS
        }
        Some(other) => unknown(other),
        None => usage(),
    }
}

This page covers what the fork adds. Everything else is in\n`maluos-slides-cli help`.\n\n## `ask`: one assistant turn, headless\n\n```\nmaluos-slides-cli ask \"REQUEST\" [--in FILE | --sample] [--out FILE]\n                      [--mode answer|confirm|autopilot] [--yes]\n                      [--provider anthropic|openai|ollama] [--model NAME]\n                      [--json] [--quiet] [--max-rounds N] [--stdin]\n```\n\nOpens FILE (`.deckcraft` or `.pptx`), the sample deck, or a new presentation; runs one turn of\nthe same assistant the app's pane uses (`maluos-slides-assist`); saves to `--out`. The answer\nstreams to stdout, tool calls and plans to stderr, so `ask … > answer.txt` keeps the answer and\nthe terminal shows the work.\n\n- **Modes** are the pane's: `answer` reads and explains; `confirm` (default) shows each change\n  as a plan and, on a terminal, asks `y/N/q`; in a script (stdin not a terminal) plans are\n  declined unless `--yes`; `autopilot` applies changes at once and still asks for deletions and\n  new or opened presentations.\n- **Provider**: `--provider`, else the first with a key in the environment\n  (`MALUOS_SLIDES_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, the same for OpenAI), else Ollama at\n  `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` (`MALUOS_SLIDES_OLLAMA_URL` overrides). `--model` names the model;\n  each provider has a default.\n- **`--json`** prints one object at the end instead of the streamed answer:\n\n```json\n{\"answer\": \"…\", \"rounds\": 3, \"toolCalls\": [{\"name\": \"run_command\", \"input\": {…}, \"ok\": true, \"summary\": \"{\\\"id\\\":291,\\\"index\\\":8}\"}],\n \"commands\": [\"slide.new\"], \"touchedSlides\": [8], \"removedSlides\": 0, \"plans\": 1, \"declined\": 0, \"refused\": 0,\n \"usage\": {\"inputTokens\": 25332, \"outputTokens\": 984, \"cacheReadInputTokens\": 0},\n \"undo\": \"Assistant: add a closing slide that thanks the audience\", \"stopped\": null, \"error\": null, \"saved\": \"out.pptx\"}\n```\n\n- **Exit status**: 0 when the turn ended with an answer (even if plans were declined); 1 when the\n  model call failed, the deck could not be opened or saved, or an option was wrong.\n\nExamples:\n\n```\nmaluos-slides-cli ask \"add a closing slide that thanks the audience\" --sample --mode autopilot --out out.pptx\nmaluos-slides-cli ask \"tighten every title to five words\" --in deck.pptx --out deck.pptx --yes --json\necho \"what is this deck about?\" | maluos-slides-cli ask --stdin --in deck.pptx --mode answer\n```\n\nTests: `cargo nextest run -p maluos-slides-cli ask` (argument parsing; ## 🤖 Claude

Phase 3.7 is done, committed as `b34bc04a` and pushed. That completes every planned step of Phase 3.

**What landed.** A new `ask` subcommand in the CLI, as a fork module with fenced hooks in the dispatcher and the help table.

```
maluos-slides-cli ask "add a closing slide that thanks the audience" --sample --mode autopilot --out out.pptx
maluos-slides-cli ask "tighten every title" --in deck.pptx --out deck.pptx --yes --json
```

- It runs one turn of the same assistant the pane uses, on a file, the sample deck or a new presentation, and saves the result.
- The answer streams to stdout and the tool calls and plans go to stderr, so redirecting stdout keeps the answer clean.
- The three modes match the pane. In confirm mode a terminal gets a y/N/q prompt. A script with no terminal has its plans declined unless it passes `--yes`.
- `--json` prints one report object at the end: answer, rounds, tool calls, commands, touched slides, usage, undo label, errors and the saved path.
- The provider defaults to the first one with a key in the environment, else Ollama. That selection now lives in the assistant crate and is shared by the pane and the CLI, so the two can never disagree. The earlier preview example is gone.

**Verification.** Four tests cover argument parsing, a scripted turn that edits the sample deck and saves a deck the engine reopens with nine slides, plans declined without `--yes` and approved with it, and a reported model error. 361 tests pass across the five new and touched crates. Clippy, rustfmt, layering, assets and the wasm check are green. A live run against the Ollama cloud model took four rounds, added the slide with a fade transition, saved the file, and produced JSON a script parsed. The command is documented in `docs/maluos-slides/cli.md`.

**Phase 3 as a whole.** The model client, the shared tool table, the deck context, the loop, the safety rails, the pane and the CLI are all in place and verified live. What the plan still lists for later: the HTTP/JSON API over the same table from decision D9, the vault key source, prompt caching to cut the per-turn input cost, and the weekly upstream sync from step 2.9. Phase 4 then starts the slides-specific depth, beginning with building a whole deck from a document.
